items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Hoagy and I used to be very close. ... I did a lot of his early things with him. I mean arranging. ... Hoagy said he was going to come along with the band for a little while and we could work together

ctx.x: It's been said of that. Do you agree with that?
I agree with it to a certain extent, yes. He did a lot of that. Hoagy and I used to be very close.

He did -- I remember when he was doing that and before he got lyrics, he was crazy about (sings) , now that's Trumbauer's part, see. (sings) that's Bix's, see. Now, then Hoagy, he comes in "(Stardust)" you know, it sounds a lot --
